citation.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

cited_by.title: CCCA: scarring hair loss at the crown

record.population: 17 men with biopsy-confirmed CCCA, one US academic centre, 2012 to 2022
record.finding: Average age 43; 88.2% identified as Black. Scalp itch was the commonest symptom; few reported high-risk hair practices; none had type 2 diabetes. The authors say CCCA should be considered in adult Black men with hair loss.
